reviews.comment: If you dont go to her class you WILL NOT pass.

reviews.comment: Great professor who is clear about expectations regarding the course, the only class that I dreaded skipping, a lot of participation but overall interesting stuff.

reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof O'Reilly was great. Very knowledgable and well traveled. Attendance not mandatory but go to class to have more insight on the lecture slides she posts in canvas. 3 exams and one final that can replace your lowest exam grade.
